literature_notes: MOSMO is a 4-TM protein (TM1: 4-24, TM2: 69-89, TM3: 101-121, TM4: 142-161) with both its N-terminus (residues 1-3) and C-terminus (residues 162-167) in the intracellular compartment. The only extracellular surfaces are ECL1 (residues 25-68) and ECL2 (residues 122-141). L4 is the sole ledger line reporting a tag on MOSMO itself: a C-terminal TwinStrep or Rho1D4 tag on the full-length membrane protein — but the C-terminus (residue 167, G) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so this is not a surface site. L1/L2/L3 report a C-terminal HA tag on mosmoa, the zebrafish MOSMO paralog; mosmoa shares the same 4-TM topology, placing its C-terminus intracellularly as well, and no residue number is given. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 or ECL2 of MOSMO or a close ortholog. With zero ledger support for an extracellular insertion, the correct answer is an empty sites list.
